## 近期结论
- **exp_006_theta_extraction_j13** (failed): Extract posterior theta from J=13 IRT to compute theta_3B - theta_1.5B ability difference across MMLU domains, providing evidence on whether 3B models have systematically higher ability than 1.5B.
- **exp_009_deepseek_eval** (negative): DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B eval tests whether reasoning-distilled models can serve as IRT respondents via standard logprob-based MC evaluation; GSM8K generative eval expected valid, MMLU/ARC MC format expected incompatible with CoT reasoning
- **exp_009_3b_instruct_eval** (success): Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct zero-shot eval provides cross-family IRT calibration baselines: instruct-tuned models without contamination training serve as uncontaminated respondents for IRT parameter estimation

# Idea Inbox

- [2026-05-16] RRF ablation: 剔除 s2 (Min-K++) 信号后重新计算 RRF exposure scores，观察 γ identifiability 是否变化。动机：Reviewer 观察到 s2_minkpp 跨浓度几乎无差异，可能是噪声信号。如果剔除 s2 后 γ 不变或更好，说明 s2 对 IRT 无贡献可简化 pipeline。
- [2026-05-17] Hierarchical/family-stratified gamma model: exp006_cross_family_pooled_irt 证明 gamma 在跨家族池化时崩塌到 0（ARC 从 0.73→0.002），说明 gamma 是 family-specific 参数。改进方向：在 IRT 模型中引入 hierarchical gamma 结构，让每个 model family 有独立 gamma_f，共享 hyperprior gamma~N(mu_gamma, sigma_gamma)。这样既能检测 within-family contamination，又能量化 cross-family 异质性。实现：修改 Stan 模型加 family indicator，估计 gamma_f 向量。预期：(1) within-family gamma 恢复显著性 (2) sigma_gamma 量化家族间差异 (3) 支持论文 "family-specificity as diagnostic finding" 叙事。风险：N per family 可能不足（当前 Llama 仅 4 models），需更多 family 或更多 model variants。
## ACTIVE"}
